description: Azure Farm grows Blueberries, Blackberries, and Grapes in Simpsonville, SC. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
